notes: Crumbl's San Francisco store, named in issue #279, read from the store's own page on 2026-09-12. Crumbl groups its stores by metropolitan area: https://crumblcookies.com/stores/ca/san-francisco-area links four, and only Lakeshore is in the city — Berkeley, Foster City and Walnut Creek are the other three. The sitemap's 306 store pages name no other San Francisco store; the 66 in California are filed under seven areas and the city appears in one of them. The store page carries a schema.org Bakery/LocalBusiness block with the address, the coordinates and the opening hours, and two fetches on 2026-09-12 agreed on all of it. Its `aggregateRating` and `priceRange` describe the merchant rather than the building and stay off the page. Crumbl publishes no Sunday hours, which the renderer prints as closed. The issue's referral link is a cmbl.co short link that redirects to an AppsFlyer OneLink opening the Crumbl app at the invite, so it reaches neither this store nor a web page, and its REFERRALS row carries a note saying so. The issue states the referrer's side of the offer — five loyalty Crumbs once the invited person first buys — and neither Crumbl's rewards page nor its terms state anything the invited person gets beyond membership, so the button says what is published: joining Crumbl Rewards earns Crumbs on every order (10 per dollar at the default Bronze status). One REFERRALS row, `crumbl`, for the one store.

coverage.remaining: None. Crumbl lists one store in San Francisco; the other three in its 'San Francisco area' are in Berkeley, Foster City and Walnut Creek.
